2895.title: Pi omits local files from prompt text
2895.rootCauseOneLine: The Pi input converter has no localFile branch, so mixed prompts lose paths and file-only prompts become empty.
2895.proposedFix: Convert each localFile input to the existing path-bearing text marker and keep turn and steer regression tests.
2895.caveats: The check used the real Pi bridge with its hermetic fake RPC. It did not repeat host staging or a paid provider turn.
